newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police seize pirated CD-roms.
newsitem.headline: Italian police seize pirated CD-roms.

text.p: Police in Italy have seized more than 40,000 pirated CD-roms and floppy disks in a crackdown on black market sales of computer software, the Italian news agency ANSA reported on Tuesday.
It said 21 people faced charges of copyright violation, tax evasion and commercial fraud following the operation in the western port of Livorno. Police were not available for comment.
ANSA said the group was suspected of downloading copyright-protected programmes from Internet sites for illegal sale.

Several workshops used to assemble the pirated software were shut down. Police also confiscated video recorders, printers, computer monitors, CD-rom drives, several modems and a programme to remove copy protection devices from original software.
